parameters.geometry_datum: Historical construction-GL controls; H23 is treated as a roof band. Current nominal150m/250m visitor names remain separate; present finished-floor conversion and facade mapping are not surveyed.

base_appearance.slenderness_scope: R08 multiplies retained nominal primary sizes by0.70 (720-to-504mm at ground, 525-to-367.5mm continuation); lacing and arch plate sizes are separate photo fits. Axes and gross cage remain unchanged. Not a measured section schedule.
base_appearance.leg_continuation_scope: The four-member gross leg assemblies continue smoothly from ground through the former 80m modelling boundary to the Main Deck. Continuation stations, cage taper, constant 525mm H appearance sections, short branch links and fitted end laps are visual assumptions, not recovered original member or connection designs.
base_appearance.scope: H3 GL40m and 80m foot-axis spacing are published structural controls. Arch depth, profile and web sizes, panel layout, FootTown 48x44m plan, facade bands, cladding and rooftop equipment are photograph/drawing-guided appearance assumptions, not surveyed dimensions or structural design.

upper_equipment.projection_definition: Additional X and Y half-width at corner tips, not a surveyed radial projection.
upper_equipment.scope: Photo-guided outboard appearance from the operator photograph. Heights, projections, directions, bracket sections, service floors and circular covers are model fits, not measured installation coordinates or an original equipment schedule. Current inventory and photo date are unverified; no broadcaster or radio-system assignment is asserted.

upper_shaft_outline.scope: Photo-guided appearance fit of the shaft between the Main Deck roof and historical H23 roof control. End radii and tangents match the retained reference profile; intermediate half-widths are fitted, not original surveyed coordinates or a structural member schedule.

H13.status: Historical H13 plan recorded separately; its function and mapping to the current facade remain unverified

H23.datum_scope: Historical structural roof band; not a verified present visitor finished-floor elevation.

detail.member_profiles: graded built-up H/I appearance chords; four schematic connection families at twenty selected nodes
detail.scope: R07 distinguishes the in-plane deep arch truss, continuous tapered primary legs below the Main Deck and a photo-guided FootTown envelope. The shaft beneath the Top Deck uses a local smooth fitted taper; deck shells, core, stairs and upper antenna remain. Original appearance detail; route, risers, sections, connections, glass, building dimensions and light positions are schematic assumptions.

deck_specs.datum_scope: H23 roof GL223550; the internal floor GL220550 and the current facade correspondence are appearance interpretations, separate from the operator nominal250m.

assumptions.zh: 总高333m、脚基准轴距80m及施工图H3/H11/H23/H27标高有公开依据。未标注的宽度、H中间分节、拱曲线及截面仍是图面解释和建模近似；双层GL125000是从GL120000加5m层距的解释。官方150m/250m案内值与几何GL解释分列；H11外壳对应与H23屋顶的解释均未实测核定；R06内部GL220550楼板为假设。不是测绘或原设计复原。
assumptions.ja: 全高333m・脚基準軸間80mと施工図H3/H11/H23/H27は公表値。無記入の幅・中間H節間・アーチ曲線・断面は図面解釈と近似です。GL125000はGL120000から5mの層間を解釈。公式案内150m/250mとモデルGLを分離し、床位置との対応もモデル上の解釈で、実測・原設計復元ではありません。
assumptions.en: Published controls cover333m overall height,80m leg-axis spacing and construction H3/H11/H23/H27 GL. Unlabelled widths, belts, arch curve and sections remain interpreted approximations; GL125000 interprets a5m upper-floor interval aboveGL120000. Official150m/250m guidance values are separate from geometricGL. H23 is treated as a historical roof band; the R06 internalGL220550 floor is an appearance assumption, not a surveyed present-day finished-floor conversion.

assumptions.zh: 地面GL=0、屋面Z=18300；主展望层GL120000/125000、上部H23屋顶GL223550（假设内部楼板220550），官方150m/250m案内值另列。24梯跑600踢面为约600阶公开描述的示意布置，路径、踢面、260mm踏面和平台尺寸均非原建筑实测。R04按宽面组合柱形态表达H/I主材，细部截面未核实。
assumptions.ja: 地盤GL=0、屋上Z=18300、モデルの主展望外殻・仮定床GL120000/125000・H23屋根GL223550（内部床220550は仮定）。公式案内150m/250mは別記。24折返し・600段は公表の約600段をもとにした独自配置です。経路、蹴上げ、踏面260mm、踊場寸法、H/I組立主材・八角副材は実測仕様ではありません。
assumptions.en: Ground GL=0, roof Z=18300; interpreted model shell/floor GL120000/125000 and H23 roofGL223550 (assumed inner floorGL220550) are separate from official150m/250m visitor names. The 24-flight/600-rise staircase is an original schematic arrangement informed by the published approximate 600 steps; route, rises, 260 mm treads and landings are not measured specifications. R04 uses graded built-up H/I appearance chords with unverified sections; braces retain octagonal prisms.

assumptions.zh: R11将模型GL80–120m主展望台下方的旧整面大X和密集横圈，改为与GL40–80m下段一致的四列交叉格网、横带及竖材。新分带80/93/106/120m、杆件和短接件为照片引导的演示假设，不是原设计的逐杆复原。保留R10整体主脚、拱架与真实开孔，保留上方轮廓、展望台、核心、楼梯和天线。既有节点局部形状不变，其相关构件引用映射到实际存在的连接件。以下R10及更早记录作为历史。
assumptions.ja: R11はモデルGL80–120mの主展望施設下にある旧一面大形X・細かい水平環を、GL40–80m下段と同じ四列の交差格子・横帯・縦材へ置換します。80/93/106/120mの分帯、部材と短い接合材は写真に基づくモデル仮定で、原設計の全材配置の復元ではありません。R10の一体主脚・アーチと実開口、上部輪郭・展望施設・コア・階段・アンテナを保持します。既存接合部の局部形状は保ち、関連材の参照を実在する新接合材へ対応させます。以下のR10以前は履歴です。
assumptions.en: R11 replaces the model GL80–120m full-face X and closely spaced horizontal rings beneath the Main Deck with the same four-column crossed grid, belts and verticals as the GL40–80m lower section. The 80/93/106/120m stations, members and short connectors are photo-guided demonstration assumptions, not a reconstructed original member schedule. R10 gross legs, arches and real openings, upper outline, decks, core, stairs and antenna are retained. Existing node geometry remains; related-member references map to actual new connectors. R10 and earlier descriptions below are historical.

assumptions.zh: R10修正下部主材的建模层级：每根塔脚及每面拱架按整体组合材表达，取消四根各自带小格构的独立小梁。连续宽盖板与带真实开口的整体腹面形成同一构件，原四角轴仅保留为定位参考。沿用既有塔脚位置、拱口和上部外形控制；宽度、板厚、孔形、缀板与接头均为照片引导的演示假设。这种整体组合材不是一根热轧实心钢材，也未恢复实物隐蔽结构。下面R09及更早说明为历史。
assumptions.ja: R10は下部主材のモデル階層を修正します。各主脚と各面のアーチを一体の組立材で表し、それぞれ小さな格構を持つ四本の独立梁を置換します。連続する広い添板と実開口を持つ腹面が同じ部材を構成し、旧四隅の軸は位置参照のみとして残します。主脚位置・アーチ開口・上部外形の制御を継承しますが、幅・板厚・孔形・綴り板・継手は写真に基づくモデル仮定です。単一の圧延実体鋼材や隠れた実物構造を復元したものではありません。以下のR09以前は履歴です。
assumptions.en: R10 corrects the lower-member modelling hierarchy: each leg and face arch is represented as one built-up assembly, replacing four separate miniature lattice beams. Continuous broad cover plates and webs with real openings belong to the same member; the former four corner axes remain location references. Existing foot locations, arch opening and upper outline controls are retained. Widths, plate thicknesses, openings, battens and joints are photo-guided demonstration assumptions. One built-up assembly does not mean one solid rolled-steel section or a recovered hidden structure. R09 and earlier descriptions below are historical.

assumptions.zh: R09将下部主材、拱弦及横斜杆的统一H/I或八角实心近似改为连续盖板、角形边缘和矩形缀板/三角缀条的透空组合材。开口是STEP和GLB共有的真实几何；接点处的短隔板维持既有连接。主脚轴线、拱洞、上部塔身、展望台、天线和R08附属构件保持。继承的外包尺寸以及板厚、分格、隔板、截面族分配均为照片参考假设，不能据此判定实物隐蔽构造或钢材规格。以下R08及更早说明为历史记录，不再表示现行下部构件均为H形或箱管。
assumptions.ja: R09は下部主材・アーチ弦材・横斜材の一律なH/I形・八角実体の近似を、連続する添板、山形の縁材、矩形の綴り板または三角形のラチスを持つ組立材に変更します。開口はSTEPとGLBで共通の実形状で、接点の短い隔板は既存の取付部をつなぎます。主脚軸線・大きなアーチ開口・上部塔体・展望施設・アンテナ・R08付属材を保持します。継承した外包寸法、板厚・割付・隔板・断面族の割当ては写真を参考にした仮定です。隠れた面や実物の鋼材規格の復元ではありません。以下のR08以前の記録は履歴であり、現行下部材を一律にH形鋼や箱形鋼管とするものではありません。
assumptions.en: R09 replaces uniform lower H/I-like and octagonal-solid approximations with built-up cover plates, angle-like edges and rectangular battened or triangular laced open webs. Voids are shared native STEP/GLB geometry; short fitted diaphragms retain existing attachment contacts. Leg axes, gross arch openings, upper shaft, decks, antenna and R08 fittings remain. Inherited envelopes, plate thicknesses, subdivisions, diaphragms and family assignments are photo-guided assumptions, not a surveyed hidden-section or steel-grade schedule. Earlier R08 and older descriptions below are historical, not current lower-member H/box-tube classifications.

assumptions.zh: R08按参考照片减细下部主材及腹杆：主弦截面为R07的0.70，地面宽720→504mm、续接段525→367.5mm，拱架H形外观450×600→320×420mm。主脚轴线、拱顶及拱架轴间深度保持。两展望台之间增加111个独立外挑支架、保守床及圆形设备罩，42处主安装点随实际直线主弦定位。尺寸、方向和布置为照片拟合；照片年代和现用设备表未核定，不分配广播系统名称。下列R07条目保留作历史控制说明；现行断面以R08参数为准。
assumptions.ja: R08は下部の主材・腹材を写真に合わせて細くし、主弦断面をR07の0.70（地上720→504mm、継続部525→367.5mm）、アーチH外観を450×600→320×420mmとします。主脚軸線・アーチ頂部・弦軸間隔は保持。両展望施設間に別名の外挑支架・保守床・円形機器カバー111個を追加し、42の主要取付点を実際の直線主弦へ配置します。寸法・方向・割付は写真近似で、写真年代と現用設備表は未確認。以下のR07記録は履歴で、現行断面はR08の値を参照します。
assumptions.en: R08 reduces lower primary and secondary appearance sections: primary sizes are0.70 of R07 (ground720→504mm, continuation525→367.5mm); arch H appearance450×600→320×420mm. Leg axes, arch crown and chord-axis separation stay fixed.111 separately named outboard brackets, service floors and circular covers are added between the decks, with42 primary mounts following actual straight chords. Dimensions, directions and inventory are photo-guided fits; photo date and current equipment schedule are unverified. The R07 notes below describe retained history; R08 parameters govern current section sizes.

assumptions.zh: R07将下部四面拱架分为立面内的上下弦杆、三角腹杆与前后连接。主腿组合柱由地面连续延伸至模型GL125m主展望台下，消除80m处的中断；80–125m的525mm主材宽度及组合柱1000→450mm半宽收分属于照片引导的假设，腹杆仍保持较细层次。H3的GL40m及80m塔脚轴距沿用公开控制；拱深、板件截面、节点和分格为拟合。FootTown的48×44m外形、五段立面层高、墙窗比例及屋顶附属体也不是实测平面。特别展望台下的模型GL130–223.55m塔身采用局部单调收分，端部半宽9900/3950mm及两端切线衔接既有轮廓，中间线形为照片拟合；原profile数组仅保留为参考控制。相关支承随实际主材移动，展望台外壳、核心、楼梯、天线及区间外形状保持。
assumptions.ja: R07は下部四面のアーチを立面内の上下弦・三角腹材・前後連結として分けます。主脚の組柱を地上からモデルGL125mの主展望施設下まで連続させ、80mでの打切りを除きます。80–125mの主材幅525mmと組柱半幅1000→450mmの収束は写真近似で、腹材は細い階層を保ちます。H3のGL40mと塔脚軸間80mは公表制御を継承し、アーチ成・断面・接合・割付は近似です。FootTownの48×44m外形・五段の立面階高・壁窓比・屋上付属体も実測平面ではありません。特別展望施設下のモデルGL130–223.55mは局所的な単調収束形状とし、端部半幅9900/3950mmと接線を既存輪郭に接続します。中間輪郭は写真近似で、元profile配列は参照制御として保持します。支持材は実主材に追従し、展望施設外装・コア・階段・アンテナと区間外を保持します。
assumptions.en: R07 separates the four lower arches into in-plane chords, triangular webs and front/back links. Primary leg cages continue from ground to the modelGL125m Main Deck, removing the80m cutoff. The80–125m525mm member width and1000-to-450mm cage half-width taper are photo-guided assumptions; braces remain finer. Published H3GL40m and80m foot-axis spacing remain controls; arch depth, plate sections, joints and subdivision are fitted. FootTown48x44m, five facade bands, wall/glazing proportions and rooftop housing are not surveyed plans. A local monotone convex taper removes the shoulder beneath the special deck from modelGL130 to223.55m, matching9900/3950mm endpoint half-widths and retained tangents. Intermediate widths are photo-guided fits; the original profile array remains reference controls. Actual connected supports follow the frame; deck shells, core, stairs, antenna and geometry outside this interval remain.

assumptions.zh: R05主展望台两层外轮廓分别参考历史H11的27m方形、H12的28m方形；H13的29×24m历史平面独立记录（功能未核定），不作为当前外幕墙边界。R06将H23的13m圆形细分为48面，H23作为屋顶控制；上部H24环形平台、上下白色钢架和小型抛物面设备参照照片拟合。2019改修窄窗、浅色底缘与清扫轨道参照供应商实景；分格、倾角、板厚、现况对应及H23附近塔身轴线收分仍为近似。
assumptions.ja: R05は歴史的なH11の27m角・H12の28m角を各階の外形参考とし、H13の29×24m歴史平面（用途未確認）は現在の外装境界に流用せず別記します。R06はH23の直径13m円を48面で近似し、H23を屋根制御とします。H24の環状保守床・上下の白い架構・小型反射鏡は写真近似です。2019年改修の細い窓枠・明色の下面・清掃軌道は製作者写真を参照し、割付・勾配・板厚・現況との対応・H23付近の塔体軸線はモデル仮定です。
assumptions.en: R05 uses historical H11 27m-square and H12 28m-square controls for separate deck levels. The H13 29x24m historical plan (function unverified) is recorded independently, not used as the current facade boundary. R06 samples the H23 13m circle with48 facets and treats H23 as a roof control. Its separate H24 ring platform, white framing and small reflectors are photo-guided fits. Supplier photographs guide2019 narrow glazing frames, pale soffits and cleaning tracks; divisions, slopes, thicknesses, current-state mapping and nearby tower-axis taper remain approximations.

assumptions.zh: R05补充H25-H27数字天线分组与SG内外两层格构。宫地No28记载ST更换为450mm BOX角柱；模型墙厚、设备尺寸、节距、SG杆径、连接及H27承接均为假设，不含临时吊运平台，也不进行制振或结构计算。
assumptions.ja: R05はH25-H27のデジタルアンテナ群とSGの内外架構を追加します。STは宮地No28の更新記録に基づく450mm BOX角柱です。壁厚・機器寸法・節間・SG部材径・接合・H27取合いは仮定で、仮設荷揚げ足場や制振・構造解析は含みません。
assumptions.en: R05 adds H25-H27 digital antenna banks and separate inner/outer SG frames. The ST is a450mm BOX post following the Miyaji No28 replacement record; its wall, equipment dimensions, bay pitch, SG sections, joints and H27 interface remain assumptions. Temporary hoisting stages, damping response and structural capacity are not modelled.

assumptions.zh: R06按2012年天线供应商Fig5表达上下两组环形阵列：每组30片/行、5行，高5300mm，间隔500mm，外径上12876mm、下13400mm，内支撑圈11800mm。总300片取代四方板片。绝对GL240550起点、板厚、缝隙、支撑、下方两行短阵列与设备平台为图像拟合。旧频道标签不表示当前运营用途；2014后SG补强与BOX450 ST保留。
assumptions.ja: R06は2012年の製作者Fig5に基づく上下二組の環状配列です。各組30枚/段・5段・高さ5300mm、間隔500mm、上径12876mm・下径13400mm、支持円11800mmの計300枚で四方の板列を置換。絶対GL240550、板厚・目地・支持材・下部二段短配列・保守床は画像近似です。旧チャンネル表記を現用用途とは扱わず、2014年後のSG補強とBOX450 STは保持します。
assumptions.en: R06 follows the supplier2012 Fig5: two circular arrays, each30 panels per row and5 rows,5300mm high,500mm apart, upper diameter12876mm, lower13400mm and support circle11800mm,300 panels total. Absolute startingGL240550, shell thickness, seams, supports, lower short arrays and service platform are image fits. Historical channels do not identify current use; post2014 SG reinforcement and BOX450 ST remain.

assumptions.zh: R04的20个钢结构节点、H/I外观截面、板厚、加劲肋、铆钉头数量/尺寸/间距与布置均为演示假设。铆接特征参考历史资料，未复原原设计或历次加固节点，也未验算节点/锚固承载力。
assumptions.ja: R04の20箇所の鋼接合部、H/I外観断面、板厚、補剛材、リベット頭の数・寸法・間隔・配置はモデル仮定です。歴史資料を参考にした外観表現であり、原設計・改修接合部の復元や接合・定着の耐力照査ではありません。
assumptions.en: The twenty R04 steel nodes, H/I appearance sections, plate/stiffener thicknesses and rivet-head counts, sizes, pitch and placement are demonstration assumptions. Historical riveting character informs appearance; original/retrofit connections and connection/anchorage capacities have not been reconstructed or calculated.

source_references.title: IHI公開写真：東京タワー建設時の塔脚・アーチ
source_references.reference_notes: Historical construction photograph shows wide built-up leg members and triangulated arch framing. It guides the in-plane depth and member hierarchy, not surveyed sections or present-day retrofit connections.

source_references.title: 竹中工務店 東京タワー改修・外観写真
source_references.reference_notes: Photographs guide the lower building wall/glazing contrast and broad low envelope. The R07 FootTown plan, facade levels and rooftop housing are model fits. Published renovation project area is not treated as a FootTown footprint or a measured plan.

source_references.title: 山森一之（古河C&B技術部）親局用アンテナ，中継局用送受信アンテナ 2012 p979 Fig5
source_references.reference_notes: Manufacturer-authored historical array drawing. Diameters and group heights are separate from model-fitted absolute GL, seam widths, thickness, support members and lower short-array sizes. Historical station/channel assignments are not current operating-use claims.

source_references.title: 川上春夫 RFワールド No1 pp42-43 東京タワーの地デジ送信用アンテナ
source_references.reference_notes: Original technical explanation confirms30 panels per row, five rows and upper/lower groups, with the same dimensioned geometry. Historic channel text is not reused as current equipment-use metadata.

source_references.title: 日本地震工学会掲載 風間了 実在建物の振動性状 p96-97 / 内藤ほか1962 Fig3
source_references.reference_notes: Historical 1962 paper figure reproduced in the JAEE-hosted volume (PDF pages105-106, printed96-97). H13 is an independently recorded historical plan; its function and mapping to the current facade remain unverified. Original observations at120m/223m support separating historical/construction GL from current nominal150m/250m guidance; no verified conversion is asserted.

source_references.title: LIXIL 東京タワー 2019カーテンウォール改修
source_references.reference_notes: Primary supplier exterior photographs inform narrow vertical mullions, fine transoms, light soffits and exterior gondola-cleaning tracks. Model bay counts, exact slopes, frame widths and glass thickness remain appearance assumptions.

source_references.title: LIXILリニューアル 東京タワー改修前後
source_references.reference_notes: 2019 after-renovation exterior and interior photographs guide current facade character; no supplier photograph is redistributed with the model.

source_references.title: 宮地技報 No18 東京タワー塔体補強報告 p86 図1
source_references.reference_notes: The model interprets observation-shell positions from H11/H23 structural bands at GL120000/223550, with an assumed 5000mm main-floor interval. These are not independently verified visitor finished-floor levels; unlabelled H belts, widths and arch curvature are traced approximations. Historical retrofit figure, not a current surveyed as-built model.

source_references.title: 宮地技報 No28 東京タワー耐震改修報告 p65 図1
source_references.reference_notes: Later retrofit drawing confirms H27 GL252650 and upper SG/ST zones.
